name: game-loop
description: The light part of an AI game studio. One playable slice, project assets, a playtest judge, and rollback. No desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Build a game one playable change at a time. Use files already in the project for art and audio. Judge the running game, and roll back only your own files if the slice got worse.
defaultPrompt: Use $game-slice to add one playable change
Use $game-assets for art that lives in the project
Use $game-judge on the running game before calling it done
